assumptions.ja: 無次元1D標的p=.5N(−6,1)+.5N(6,1)、平均0/分散37/正側占有.5。3固定seed・4鎖、burn1024、保持16384標本/鎖。prefix1024/4096/16384は入れ子で独立再試行ではありません。棄却と自己遷移を保持します。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless1D target p=.5N(−6,1)+.5N(6,1), mean0/variance37/positive occupancy.5. Three fixed seeds, four chains,1024 warmup and16384 retained draws/chain. Prefixes1024/4096/16384 are nested, not independent replications. Rejections/self-transitions are retained.

limits.ja: 固定seed・有限予算の教育用実験です。局所Gaussian RWも理論上は既約なMHであり、有限時間のtrappingを非エルゴードなアルゴリズムとは呼びません。小さいRhat・大きいESS・プールCDFの一致は未発見の峰を除外せず、既知対称性のreflection提案も一般多峰ソルバーではありません。量子計算は追加しません。 定数observableのESS=NというArviZ raw規約を混合の証拠にしません。全同値はnull＋status、鎖ごとに異なる定数のRhatはnull＋infinite-separationとして、ライブラリの巨大finite/infを残し通常有限値の一致点から除外します。bulk ESSは原スケール平均のMCSEへ流用しません。
limits.en: An educational fixed-seed, finite-budget experiment. The local Gaussian RW is theoretically irreducible MH; finite-time trapping is not called a nonergodic algorithm. Small Rhat, large ESS and pooled-CDF agreement cannot rule out undiscovered modes. Symmetry-informed reflection is not a generic multimodal solver. No quantum calculations. ArviZ raw constant-ESS=N is not evidence of mixing. Globally identical values yield null/status; differing per-chain constants yield null/infinite-separation Rhat while retaining raw huge-finite/infinite library values outside ordinary finite comparisons. Bulk ESS is not a raw-mean MCSE estimator.

references.author: A. Vehtari, A. Gelman, D. Simpson, B. Carpenter and P.-C. Bürkner
references.title: Rank-Normalization, Folding, and Localization: An Improved R-hat for Assessing Convergence of MCMC (with Discussion)

review.ja: 訂正済み著者公開PDFの第3–4節、式4.1の分母S+1/4への2021-06-22訂正、定数indicatorの注意を確認。原著の全数値実験を再現したものではありません。
review.en: Checked original sections3–4, the2021-06-22 correction of Eq4.1 to denominator S+1/4, and the constant-indicator warning. This does not reproduce every original numerical experiment.

review.ja: 原著第3.3節・定理3.1/3.2で可逆性等の条件とinitial-positive/monotone列を確認。本論文473–483頁と合本の討論頁を区別。有限鎖から真のESSが厳密に分かる保証とは扱いません。
review.en: Checked section3.3 and Theorems3.1/3.2 for reversibility assumptions and initial-positive/monotone sequences. Main article pp473–483 are distinguished from combined discussion pagination; no claim gives exact true ESS from finite chains.

references.author: A. Gelman and D. B. Rubin
references.title: Inference from Iterative Simulation Using Multiple Sequences

review.ja: 原著の序論・第2節で複数鎖と分散した初期値を確認。現代のrank/folded Rhatの原典とは区別し、1992年版の全有限標本補正の再現とも呼びません。
review.en: Checked the original introduction/section2 on multiple sequences and overdispersed starts. Distinct from the later rank/folded method, and not a reproduction of every1992 finite-sample correction.

references.author: The ArviZ developers
references.title: ArviZ0.20.0 public diagnostics API and tagged source

review.ja: 公式v0.20.0のrhat/ess API、diagnostics.py/stats_utils.pyでsplit・rank・Type7 quantile・端点・定数規約を確認。commit94113176cae99a05ba41d1e93739ee2d5bdbe9b1と導入ソースSHAを照合し、atlas診断をimportしない別環境で同じ62datasetを実計算。元コード本文は転載せず、参照値・版・hash・再生成コードを同梱します。
review.en: Checked the official0.20.0 rhat/ess API and tagged source for splitting, ranks, Type7 quantiles, endpoints and constant conventions. Installed source hashes match commit94113176cae99a05ba41d1e93739ee2d5bdbe9b1;62 byte-identical datasets were actually processed in a separate environment without importing Atlas diagnostics. No upstream implementation is reproduced; values, versions, hashes and regeneration code are supplied.

title.ja: MCMC診断の独立照合：rank Rhat・bulk/tail ESS・退化条件
title.en: Independent MCMC diagnostic checks: rank Rhat, bulk/tail ESS and degeneracies

summary.ja: 同一鎖の62datasetを別環境ArviZ0.20.0で実計算し、固定recipe・入力・鎖・公式ソースSHAで結びます。通常の有限値照合と、不定値のpolicy差を分けて検査します。
summary.en: Actually process62 byte-identical datasets with separately installed ArviZ0.20.0, bound by recipe/input/chain/official-source hashes. Separate finite-value agreement from explicit degeneracy-policy differences.

algorithm.ja: 原著式から独自実装。odd長は中央1標本を落としてsplit、平均順位のBlom式は訂正済みS+1/4、fold後再rank、最大Rhatを採用。bulk ESSはrank split、tail ESSは元の全鎖のType7分位点を先に求めた≤indicatorをsplit。Geyer initial-positive/monotoneと宣言した端点処理・tau≥1/log10(total)を用い、反相関ESSをNへclipしません。
algorithm.en: Original equation-based implementation: split with the odd center dropped, average-tie Blom ranks using corrected S+1/4, re-rank folded deviations, and take the larger Rhat. Bulk ESS uses rank-split draws; tail ESS first determines Type7 quantiles on original full draws, then splits <= indicators. Use initial-positive/monotone pairs, declared endpoint handling and tau>=1/log10(total), without clipping antithetic ESS to N.

validation.ja: 実鎖9組×3prefix×x/indicator＋8小fixtureの62組。同じbytesを再生成して照合し、通常の有限値Rhat/ESS/ACFと、定数・鎖内ゼロ分散・odd・ties・shift・scaleを検査。別の直接lag和、定常AR(1)の無限列tau=(1+rho)/(1−rho)で有限推定の誤差も測定します。routineは保存参照との照合で、ArviZのその場再実行は任意の別手順です。
validation.en: 62 datasets: nine actual chains times three prefixes times x/indicator plus eight small fixtures. Regenerate and hash identical bytes; compare ordinary finite Rhat/ESS/ACF and test constants, zero within-chain variance, odd lengths, ties, shift and scale. Direct lag sums and infinite-series stationary-AR(1) tau=(1+rho)/(1−rho) provide separate checks of finite estimates. Routine runs compare stored references; live ArviZ regeneration is a separate optional procedure.

measured.scope: Same-chain ArviZ0.20.0 values were generated separately; this routine regenerates chains and compares stored references without importing ArviZ.

editorial_note.ja: 独立ライブラリとの一致は診断値の計算の照合であり、目標分布を十分探索した証明ではありません。定数や峰指示関数の変動不足は数値のESSへ置き換えず、状態と理由を併記します。負の自己相関ではESSが標本数を超える場合があり、旧Gaussian例の保守的な下限規約とは区別します。
editorial_note.en: Agreement with an independent library checks diagnostic computation; it does not prove adequate target exploration. Constants and insufficiently varying mode indicators carry explicit states and reasons rather than a reassuring numeric ESS. Negative autocorrelation can yield ESS above the draw count; this is distinct from the conservative floor used in the earlier Gaussian example.

scope.ja: 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。
scope.en: These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems.
